overview_description: Read the workflows on your instance from the settings area: list them or retrieve one.
intro: Workflow settings give read-only access to the workflows set up on your instance. You can list them and retrieve one; changes go through the workflows endpoints. This area has 2 endpoints, and all seven Exsited SDKs call every one.
notes: **This area is read only.** Every write under `/settings/workflows` is refused with `400`; create, update and delete workflows under `/workflows`.
**One workflow comes back under `workflow`.** A listing puts its records under `data`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List workflow settings
endpoints.summary: Lists the workflows on your instance from the settings area, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of workflows under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. This listing is read only; create and change workflows under `/workflows`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a workflow setting
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one workflow from the settings area by its id.
endpoints.description: Returns the workflow under `workflow`. Use the `id` a listed workflow carries.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's `id`, as the listing shows it.

code.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.

description.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.

created_by.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.

last_updated_by.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.

url.description: The path this page was read from.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.
